categories.name: Storytelling & Scenarios
categories.tagline: Sequential comic frames, problem-to-solution narrative arcs, and user journey storyboarding
categories.intro: NID cares deeply about empathy: can you depict a real person facing a real obstacle, struggling, discovering an intervention, and reaching resolution in 3 or 4 clear sequential panels?

items.name: Everyday Struggle & Functional Resolution
items.primitives: Panel 1: Wide shot establishing user and context; Panel 2: Medium shot struggle; Panel 3: Close-up hands on fix; Panel 4: Wide happy resolution
items.proportions: Varying camera angles (Wide -> Medium -> Close-up -> Extreme Wide) prevent monotonous reading
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a 4-panel comic of a rural student struggling to study in power cuts until using a solar book-clamp lamp.

items.name: Elderly Person Overcoming a Physical Barrier

items.level_3_mashup: Draw a 4-panel storyboard of an elderly grandfather learning to use a voice-activated medication reminder.

items.name: Child Discovering Nature & Sparking Curiosity

items.level_3_mashup: Draw a 4-frame comic showing a curious child designing a cardboard periscope to observe garden birds.

items.name: Monsoon Flood Crisis & Community Rescue

items.name: Commuter Missing Bus & Finding Alternative Route

items.name: Street Vendor's Morning Setup & Busy Market Rush

items.name: First-Time User Navigating a Complex Interface

items.name: Responsible Domestic Waste Segregation
items.primitives: Panel 1: Kitchen meal prep with vegetable peels and plastic wrap; Panel 2: Deliberate separation into green and blue bins; Panel 3: Handing sorted bin to sanitation collector; Panel 4: Rich compost nourishing rooftop tomato plants

items.level_3_mashup: Draw a 4-panel sequence promoting community composting in an urban apartment society.

items.primitives: Panel 1: Car tire stuck in muddy roadside ditch; Panel 2: Passing tractor driver stopping to assess; Panel 3: Working together to wedge wooden plank under spinning tire; Panel 4: Car emerging onto dry asphalt with cheerful handshake

categories.name: Basic Shapes & Perspective Foundation
categories.tagline: The geometric DNA of all physical design: boxes, cylinders, ellipses, cross-contours, and perspective grids
categories.intro: Every object in the universe is a modified cube, cylinder, cone, or sphere. If you can rotate a box in 2-point perspective and draw clean symmetric ellipses, you can draw anything.

items.name: Cube & Orthogonal Grid Construction
items.primitives: Six equal square faces meeting at 90-degree orthogonal corners with visible internal wireframe bones
items.proportions: All parallel edges converge to shared vanishing points on horizon
items.level_3_mashup: Draw three identical cubes stacked in 2-point perspective rotated 30 degrees to each other.

items.name: Cuboid / Rectangular Prism Box
items.primitives: Box with unequal length, width, and height dimensions; foundation of cars, buildings, and furniture
items.proportions: True vanishing lines test foreshortening without barrel distortion
items.level_3_mashup: Carve an ergonomic handheld radio out of a solid perspective cuboid using subtractive sketching.

items.name: Cylinder with Accurate Ellipse Minor Axes
items.primitives: Two parallel circular face ellipses joined by tangent contour lines; minor axis always aligns with cylinder centerline
items.proportions: Ellipse becomes rounder (greater degree) the further it moves from eye level
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a complex water bottle with varying cylindrical diameters along one shared centerline axis.

items.name: Cone & Conical Frustums
items.primitives: Circular base ellipse tapering to single apex vertex point; truncated cone forms frustum bucket
items.proportions: Base ellipse minor axis aligns collinear with height centerline
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a stack of three traffic safety cones showing interlocking frustum geometry.

items.name: Sphere & True Shading Terminators
items.primitives: Perfect circular boundary circle with internal elliptical great circles, core shadow terminator band, and bounce light
items.proportions: Highlight opposite to light source; soft core shadow line perpendicular to light vector
items.level_3_mashup: Render a translucent glass marble resting on a reflective chrome sphere.

items.name: Square & Triangular Pyramids
items.primitives: Polygonal ground base with triangular planar facets converging to apex point
items.proportions: Apex drops a perpendicular centerline plumb-line straight to base geometric center
items.level_3_mashup: Design an emergency pop-up solar beacon shaped like an inverted geometric pyramid.

items.name: Torus / Donut Ring Geometry
items.primitives: Circular cross-section swept along circular revolution path (tires, seals, handle loops)
items.proportions: Inner hole ellipse and outer perimeter ellipse share concentric center in perspective
items.level_3_mashup: Draw an inflatable life-preserver ring thrown into foaming turbulent water.

items.name: Hemisphere & Domestic Bowls
items.primitives: Half-sphere dome with flat circular opening rim ellipse
items.proportions: Wall thickness offset concentric to outer rim ellipse
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a ceramic soup bowl resting inside an insulated thermal silicone outer shell.

items.name: Rounded Rectangles (Pills & Fillets)
items.primitives: Orthogonal cuboids with corners filleted by quarter-cylinder tangent transitions
items.proportions: Eliminates sharp edges; standard for consumer electronics and smartphone bodies
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a sleek modern internet router with chamfered venting slots and rounded corners.

items.name: Organic Blob & Continuous Spline Forms
items.primitives: Non-orthogonal curved volumes defined by flowing cross-contour rings wrapping the 3D surface
items.proportions: Cross-contour lines communicate surface topology and thickness
items.level_3_mashup: Design an ergonomic computer mouse molded to the natural resting anatomy of human palm.

items.name: One-Point Interior Perspective Grid
items.primitives: Single central vanishing point on horizon; front walls stay orthogonal while side walls recede
items.proportions: Floor tile grid squares compress realistically as they recede into distance
items.level_3_mashup: Draw an interior view down a long train coach showing rows of seats receding to vanishing point.

items.name: Two-Point Exterior Perspective Grid
items.primitives: Two vanishing points (VP Left and VP Right) spread wide apart on horizon line; vertical edges stay plumb
items.proportions: Corner of building forms closest foreground edge to camera
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a corner street view of a lively neighbourhood tea stall and bakery.

items.name: Three-Point Dramatic Worm's Eye / Bird's Eye Grid
items.primitives: Two horizon vanishing points plus third vertical vanishing point (zenith or nadir) capturing extreme verticality
items.proportions: Vertical lines tilt sharply towards sky or ground to exaggerate towering scale
items.level_3_mashup: Draw a dramatic bird's-eye view looking down from a high balcony at pedestrians with umbrellas.

items.name: Compound Primitive Combinations (Bottle / Lamp / Drill)
items.primitives: Cylinder + Sphere = Bottle; Cuboid + Cylinder = Power Appliance; Cylinder + Cone = Torch
items.proportions: Seamless blend fillets transition between intersecting geometric solids
items.level_3_mashup: Construct an electric handheld drill from a main horizontal cylinder, vertical grip cuboid, and cone chuck.

items.name: Subtractive & Additive Form Carving
items.primitives: Starting from a raw bounding block and carving out scoops, holes, chamfers, and bevels
items.proportions: Maintains structural alignment and proportions while generating complex organic design forms
items.level_3_mashup: Carve an ergonomic game controller out of a single rectangular perspective foam block.
